content:
Sara Patel: Heads-up — BrightField Labs flagged a cross-team expansion signal this morning. They want to run a realtime doc-summarization flow across Support + Product Analytics.
Jamal Ortiz: Nice. Any numbers on expected QPS or payload size? New teams + realtime usually means bursty small requests.
Sara Patel: Sales shared rough numbers: 200 rps peak, avg 90 rps during business hours. Payloads ~2–6KB, many short contexts.
Leo Chen: 200 rps peak on hosted tier could push their per-token spend high. Also latency SLO is 300ms tail. We need to know current latency percentiles.
Sara Patel: They reported 95th ~520ms on our hosted model yesterday (chat-llama-13b-quant). Also asked about Dedicated pilot to control cost and latency.
Ana Martins: Renewal in ~90 days. They explicitly said: "If we can't hit <350ms 95p and get predictable cost, we'll evaluate other options." This is a potential renewal risk.
Jamal Ortiz: Ok flagged urgent. Sara, can you get a traffic sample or replay so eng can run profiling? Also put customer on a call tomorrow.
Sara Patel: Uploading sample trace now and scheduling a 40m sync for tomorrow 11:00 PT. I'll @Leo and @Ana on the invite.
deploy-bot: Uploaded file: https://files.redwood/internal/brightfield/replay-20260321.tar.gz (access: brightfield-cs)
Leo Chen: grabbing the replay. Quick checklist: 1) confirm model choice/quantization 2) prefix caching opportunity 3) batching window vs latency tradeoff. If they go Dedicated we can tune batch sizes aggressively.
Leo Chen: Example draft probe command I'm going to run locally:
```
loadtest --concurrency 50 --rps 200 --payload sample.json --endpoint https://api.redwood/brightfield/v1
```
Jamal Ortiz: Also note they plan to attach support chat (low context) + product analytics (longer context) to same endpoint. We should recommend splitting routes to optimize models/quantization per use case.
Ana Martins: For renewal conversation I need: 1) a one-pager on Dedicated pilot benefits (latency, pricing predictability), 2) an enablement plan + workshop dates, 3) recommended model/config options and estimated monthly cost at their projected QPS.
Sara Patel: I'll draft the one-pager and a preliminary cost estimate based on 90/200 rps profiles. Sharing by EOD.
Leo Chen: After I run the replay I'll share perf deltas for: a) hosted current config, b) hosted with prefix cache, c) Dedicated with tuned batching. Likely we'll see 95p drop from ~520ms → ~280–320ms on tuned Dedicated.
Jamal Ortiz: Great. Also capture any product feedback they shared about hallucinations in long summaries — CS noted a few examples. We should tie quality checks to the cost/latency tradeoffs.
Ana Martins: I'll prep the renewal cadence and highlight this as a risk in the account health dashboard. If we can promise a pilot with measurable SLOs in 2 weeks, that's our play.
Sara Patel: Confirmed. Next steps: 1) Leo runs replay and posts results in this thread (by EOD tomorrow), 2) Sara sends one-pager + invite, 3) Ana blocks time for renewal sync. @deploy-bot please remind us 24h before the customer call.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-22T18:00:00Z — "BrightField pilot sync in 24h" :bell:
Leo Chen: Adding note — if Dedicated isn't possible in time, consider short-term routing to a cheaper low-latency variant (smaller context model) for support traffic to buy time.
Sara Patel: Thanks team — I'll loop in Solutions Engineering if Leo needs extra hands on the replay analysis. Closing the loop here once I have the one-pager.
